name: Chamonix
tagline: Mont Blanc, glaciers and the Aiguille du Midi
summary: Chamonix sits at the foot of Mont Blanc, the highest mountain in Western Europe. Ride the cable car up the Aiguille du Midi to 3,842 m, take the rack railway to the Mer de Glace glacier, hike to Lac Blanc for the mirror view of the range, and ski or paraglide in one of the world's great mountain towns.
seasonNote: December to April for skiing, June to September for hiking; many lifts close in May and November.
arrival: Geneva Airport is 1h15 by shuttle bus; trains connect via Saint-Gervais.
gettingAround: Free local buses and trains in the valley with your guest card; lifts and cable cars to the heights.
cashTip: Cards work almost everywhere; service is included in prices, so round up only for good service.
foodTip: Tartiflette, fondue savoyarde, raclette and diots (Savoy sausages).
buyTip: Beaufort and Reblochon cheese and Génépi liqueur.
baseArea: Chamonix centre near the Aiguille du Midi station

connections.note: Airport shuttles several times a day.
